observations: Sony PlayStation 4 console with black and orange 'Black Ops III' limited edition livery.
The console is wrapped in clear plastic film.
A DualShock 4 controller is shown in a retail box with a custom anime-style skin.
The TV screen shows the PlayStation 4 dashboard with multiple game icons.
A system notification 'Ready to use. DAYSGONE.pkg' is visible in the top left of the screen.
Visible games include FC 25, WWE 2K24, and Call of Duty Black Ops 6.
The console is powered on and connected to a TV.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the official Call of Duty: Black Ops III Limited Edition console design.
Photos 1 and 2 show 13 unique game tiles; 15 is a plausible total for the library.

claims.claim: can take any game(s) of choice
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows a '.pkg' file notification, which is characteristic of a jailbroken console capable of side-loading games.

risks.risk: Optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing a physical game disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.

risks.risk: Internal storage capacity is unknown (500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Settings > Storage' screen.

risks.risk: The controller may be a third-party clone rather than original Sony hardware.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the sticker on the back of the controller.

risks.risk: Console may have overheating issues or loud fan noise common in 'fat' models.
risks.proof: A video of the console running a demanding game (like Cyberpunk 2077) for 5 minutes with audio.
risks.if_unproven: as needing internal cleaning and thermal paste replacement

proof_requests: Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the firmware version.
Photo of the 'Storage' screen showing total capacity.
Video of the disc drive working.
Photo of the back of the controller.
response.reason: The item is a clearly identified jailbroken PlayStation 4 Limited Edition. It can be priced at its worst-case hardware configuration (500GB, broken disc drive, generic controller) while accounting for the value of the jailbreak and installed games.
